title: Beginning Shakespeare

vibeProfile.oneLine: An accessible introduction to critical approaches to Shakespeare.

summary: Lisa Hopkins's Beginning Shakespeare introduces the ways scholars and critics approach Shakespeare today, from textual and historical questions to feminist, postcolonial and performance-based readings. Rather than a plot guide, it shows how to think and write critically about the plays, applying current approaches to well-known texts. Clear and student-friendly, it is a useful bridge for readers moving from simply enjoying Shakespeare to studying him seriously.
whyReadIt: A clear guide to studying Shakespeare critically, not just reading him. A useful bridge into serious study.
